content.title: Hello! I’m Susanna, a Full Stack Developer based in Finland.
lines: I started learning programming because I genuinely enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work.
I have experience with both frontend and backend development. I’ve worked with websites, APIs, databases and complete applications, and I’m currently focusing more on the backend side of development.

content.title: How I Think
lines: I’ve always liked puzzles and logic games. I enjoy situations where I have to figure something out instead of simply following an existing solution.

When I’m working on a problem, I usually start by breaking it into smaller parts. I like to understand what is happening, why it is happening, and how everything fits together before deciding how to solve it.
I also really like structure. Whether I’m writing code, organising information or working on a project, I prefer when things have a clear place and purpose.

content.title: Where It Started
lines: I actually started programming when I was around 12, although I didn’t really know that’s what I was doing.

I used to make small games in Python. I thought I was just writing stories and adding different things to my games using words, letters and a bit of logic. I wasn’t thinking about programming or becoming a developer. I just wanted to make things work the way I imagined them.
Looking back, it was probably my first introduction to programming. I was already writing code, experimenting with it, and figuring out how to make the game do what I wanted.

I stopped for a while after that and came back to programming much later. This time I understood what I was actually doing, and I realised that I still really enjoyed the same part of it: figuring things out and making something work.

content.title: What I Work With
lines: I currently work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL and REST APIs. I also have experience with GraphQL, MongoDB, Sequelize and React Native.
My frontend experience is currently stronger, but I’m actively developing my backend skills and working on projects where I can build and understand the whole application.

content.title: Currently
lines: Right now, I’m studying and building my own projects while gaining practical experience as a developer.

I’m especially interested in backend development, databases and APIs. I want to keep getting better at building applications where the different parts actually work together, instead of only focusing on one side of development.
I’m still learning a lot, and I actually enjoy that part. There is always something new to figure out.

content.title: ChoreSet
content.description: A Full Stack family task and reward application. Parents can create tasks for children, approve completed tasks and manage rewards. Built with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL.

content.title: Blog Application
content.description: A full stack blog application with a REST API for creating, viewing and deleting blog posts. Built with Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL and Sequelize.

content.title: Rate Repository
content.description: A mobile application for browsing and rating GitHub repositories. Built with React Native, TypeScript and GraphQL, with authentication and data stored in a database.
